Name: This time . I still love you-ch
Author: xinerfanyu
Description:
This mod modifies Shane's 2-heart, 4-heart, 6-heart, and 10-heart events. It also adds my personally written events: 'The Night Is Called Gentle' (8-heart), 'A Feeling Called Love' (14-heart), and 'You Are My Gift' (Shane's Birthday Event). Additionally, I have casually added some of Shane's daily dialogues. All the above are storylines written by myself. My writing skills are not very good, but I still wanted to put down my own thoughts about Shane. Also, the farmer character is my own design, so some dialogue options are just my personal opinions and do not represent everyone. The original intention of creating this mod was simply to do something for Shane. Therefore, only Shane has been modified; other characters remain unchanged. I personally am neither interested nor have the energy to write for other characters, so I hope for your understanding.

Furthermore, my English is not very good, so this mod is only available in Chinese. If other languages are needed, it depends on whether anyone else is willing to translate it. (This assumes anyone actually wants to translate this mod, since this is my first time making a mod, and I cannot guarantee quality. But for myself, I am very satisfied.) I may continue updating it in the future if someone truly likes it.

Trigger conditions: 2-heart, 4-heart, 6-heart, 10-heart remain as originally triggered.
2-heart: With 2 hearts with Shane, trigger by entering the Coal Mine Forest between 20:00 and 24:00.
4-heart: With 4 hearts with Shane, trigger by entering Marnie's Ranch at any time.
6-heart: With 6 hearts with Shane, after experiencing the 4-heart event, trigger by entering the Coal Mine Forest on a rainy day between 9:00 and 20:00.
6-heart follow-up: After the 6-heart event, trigger by leaving the farmhouse between 6:00 and 8:00 in the morning.
8-heart: With 8 hearts with Shane, trigger by entering the Beach on a rainy day between 18:00 and 23:00. (PS: After finishing, it immediately moves to the next day.)
10-heart: After triggering the original 8-heart event, while on a date with Shane, with 10 hearts, trigger by leaving the farmhouse between 6:00 and 6:30 in the morning.
10-heart follow-up: After the 10-heart event, trigger at the Bus Stop between 16:00 and 18:00.
14-heart: With 14 hearts with Shane, trigger by entering the Coal Mine Forest in winter between 14:00 and 18:00.
Birthday event: If married to Shane, on a sunny day of Spring 20, trigger at the farmhouse.
Birthday follow-up: On a sunny Spring 20, after experiencing the birthday event, trigger at the Saloon between 18:00 and 20:00.

Notes before viewing: The story is written from the perspective of a male farmer. Although the gender does not have a major impact, the experience is better from a male farmer's perspective. This mod may conflict with other mods that alter Shane's events, such as Immersive Shane, but it will not crash the game. It may only cause some events to behave unpredictably, which could be from other mods or from this mod (limited to the original 2-heart, 4-heart, 6-heart, and 10-heart events).
